{{Quote|A Container full of grain was dropped in the ''Lesser Plooriod Cluster''.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] briefing|<ref name="Imperial Pursuit 6B" />}}
The '''Lesser Plooroid Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] of twelve [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="AGSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Urce sector/Legends|Urce Space]] and the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]] lay in the cluster.

[[Hyperspace route/Legends|Hyperlanes]] used to travel through the Lesser Plooriod Cluster included [[Burna Trade Route]] and [[Entana Run]].<ref name="AIR" />

During the [[Rebellion era]], [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mox Slosin]] patrolled the cluster unsupervised, looking for Rebel activity.<ref name="AIR" />

The majestic eco-city ''[[Tafanda Bay]]'' was a popular destination for tourists and a center of commerce in the cluster.<ref name="TEGtVaV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that the Lesser Plooriod Cluster was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was a geographic feature bigger than a [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
